title: BC Telemetry Buddy  – When Your 12-Year-Old Accidentally Helps You Find a Problem
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy is an AI-powered tool that lets you ask natural language questions about Business Central telemetry data instead of writing complex KQL queries. It helped uncover a critical performance issue where a background job was wasting 67.7 hours daily through inefficient queries and missing retention policies, diagnosed in 15 minutes and fixed by adding indexes and enabling retention.
key_points: BC Telemetry Buddy uses AI and MCP to make telemetry exploration accessible through conversational questions rather than complex manual KQL analysis
The tool successfully identified a customer experiencing massive CPU waste from a queue processor doing full table scans on an unindexed table with missing retention policies
Performance improved dramatically after the fix: query count dropped from 19,946 to 18 over a week, and wasted time went from 67.7 hours to virtually zero
The tool can document investigations and save conclusions automatically, allowing for follow-up validation of fixes over time

quotes.why_it_matters: The author humorously describes the BC Telemetry Buddy as an AI tool that abstracts away complex KQL and telemetry knowledge, making it accessible to anyone asking questions in natural language.

quotes.text: One question. One answer. Immediate diagnosis with lots of details!
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the core value proposition: BC Telemetry Buddy transforms hours of manual investigation into a single conversational query, dramatically reducing time investment for performance diagnostics.
